column5: flushes deferred state: for each set bit of the two dirty words (ctx+0x38, ctx+0x3c) calls the matching state-to-register translator (blend, stencil, alpha test, scissor, cull, depth, texenv colour ...), then finishes with FUN_0004d100/FUN_00052280

(dirty2 bit 0x8) translates the GL blend state - equations 0x8006 FUNC_ADD, 0x8007 MIN, 0x8008 MAX, 0x800a SUBTRACT, 0x800b REVERSE_SUBTRACT and the source/destination RGB and alpha factors (ZERO, ONE, 0x300..0x308, 0x8001..0x8004) - into the R500 blend-control shadow words ctx+0x1a80/+0x1a84
stencil function/ops (GL_KEEP 0x1e00, REPLACE 0x1e01, INCR 0x1e02, DECR 0x1e03, INVERT 0x150a, INCR_WRAP 0x8507, DECR_WRAP 0x8508) into the stencil control shadows
alpha function (GL_NEVER 0x200 + n, LESS 0x201 .. ALWAYS 0x207) and reference value into the fragment alpha-func shadow (+0x1a4c function, +0x1a4f reference byte, +0x1bde 16-bit reference)
converts the scissor rectangle (x/y/width/height scaled by the window scale factors at +0x2814/+0x2818, clamped to the drawable) into the scissor top-left/bottom-right shadow words (+0x1b58, +0x1b10)
front-face winding (GL_CW 0x900) and cull mode (GL_FRONT 0x404, GL_BACK 0x405, GL_FRONT_AND_BACK 0x408) into the face-control shadow (+0x1b30)
copies each texture unit's 4-float colour from the state (context+0x47c + unit*0xcc) into the register shadows (+0x1f38 + unit*0x10) and into the bound program's constant table
depth function (0x200 + n) and depth range checks into the depth-control shadows (+0x1aa0 bits 1/2, +0x1aa4 function, +0x1a50 bit 0)
